headline: Germany Reaches Metalworking Wage Deal Affecting 3.7 Million Employees
summary: Germany reached a wage agreement for 3.7 million employees across the automotive, electrical, aerospace, defense, and mechanical engineering sectors amid an industrial crisis.
why: Labor agreements in Germany's powerhouse manufacturing sectors set benchmark labor cost trends for Europe's largest economy and directly affect corporate operating margins.

impacts.name: German Manufacturing
impacts.why: Broad wage settlements alter labor cost structures for major industrial and automotive corporations.
